title: The Complete Key
next_chapter_hook: The last line of the Tianji Record flickered: 'But the seventh Chess Player never truly died'—these words struck like thunder, shattering Chen Ji's soul to pieces. The seventh Chess Player, could that possibly be...

text.content: Blood dripped slowly from Chen Ji's pale palms, each drop like a funeral bell striking against fate. The sixth page unfurled slowly, ancient golden characters writhing like living serpents, finally crystallizing into a breathtaking vision—a ceaseless ring of seven light points, connected head to tail, like seven venomous serpents devouring each other. 'The Chess Game of Eternity...' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse as if he hadn't drunk water for a thousand years, 'It's not about victory or defeat at all—it's a circulatory system.'

In the center of the sixth page, a line of blood characters slowly manifested: 'The Heavenly Dao cycles, using Chess Players as fuel. Each generation of Chess Players burns through their Heavenly Fate Value and dies, their souls becoming nourishment to sustain the Chess Game's operation. The seven Chess Players are mutually causal, mutually causative of each other's deaths—only when three simultaneously release their obsessions can this eternal cycle be broken.' Chen Ji felt a violent vertigo, as if some ancient memories were being forcibly poured into his Mental Sea.

At that moment, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record within him shudder violently. Mo Xiansheng's aged voice rang out in his Mental Sea, carrying irrepressible excitement: 'Finally... finally complete! The failure ten thousand years ago wasn't because we weren't strong enough, but because we didn't know the complete method!' Chen Ji's consciousness was forcibly pulled into a chaotic space, where countless blurred figures were kneeling before him.

dialogue.content: These are the residual will of past Chess Players,' Mo Xiansheng's figure materialized beside Chen Ji, his voice carrying the weight of沧桑, 'They've all been waiting for this moment. Waiting ten thousand years, another ten thousand years.

text.content: Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings—the countless figures were too blurred to make out their features, but each radiated an energy identical to the Tianji Record within him. They were past Chess Players, his predecessors,可怜 beings trapped in this chess game for ten thousand years with no release. 'So... the key to breaking the chess game is requiring other Chess Players to willingly release their obsessions?' Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve.

dialogue.content: 'Not just releasing,' Mo Xiansheng's voice grew heavy, 'it's requiring three Chess Players to simultaneously and willingly let go of obsessions held for ten thousand years. Think about it—how much did a Chess Player sacrifice to reach today? How much did they give up? How much blood debt do they carry? Do you think they would let go easily?'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. The Chess Game of Eternity, the cycle of hundreds of millions of years—none of the Chess Players were善茬. Those who made it this far, which one didn't climb step by step over mountains of corpses and rivers of blood? For them to give up, how difficult would that be? Besides... 'Three willingly give up?' Chen Ji raised his head abruptly, 'That means I need to find two other fools like myself?'

dialogue.content: 'Fools?' Mo Xiansheng let out a desolate laugh, 'Ten thousand years ago, we were called that too. Do you think the Heavenly Eye made you 'waste' become Chess Players? Because only those abandoned by fate could possibly release their obsessions.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a chill run through him. The废物persona, the tactic of hiding strength and making a sudden move—these tricks he prided himself on, were they all designed by the Heavenly Eye? He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing this thought. Now wasn't the time to pursue this. He looked at the sixth page again, where the content had fully manifested.

'The Seventh Chess Player: Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, Eye of Reincarnation.' Chen Ji read these words aloud, his heart churning with great waves. Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, Eye of Reincarnation—these two terms were all too familiar to him. His sister Chen Nian was the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key' taken away by the Holy Sect! Could it be that... 'The seventh Chess Player never truly died,' the last line of the sixth page flickered, 'She has been waiting to be awakened.'

Chen Ji felt a blaze of fury rising to his celestial spirit. His sister had been missing for so many years, he had been searching endlessly—never imagining the answer would be here! Chen Nian wasn't some innocent person captured by the Holy Sect, she was the most critical piece in this Chess Game of Eternity! 'So the Holy Sect took her not because she was useful, but because she was a chess piece?' Chen Ji's voice was cold as ice, 'Same as me?'

choice.prompt: The truth has been revealed, but the path ahead remains shrouded in mist. Chen Ji must make a choice: how to break this Chess Game of Eternity?

choices.description: Proactively search for other Chess Players, attempt to persuade them to release their ten-thousand-year obsessions, and jointly break the chess game.
choices.visible_reward: Gain potential allies, establish an alliance to break the game
choices.risk_hint: Other Chess Players may directly take action

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, returning the sixth page to his Mental Sea. Searching for other Chess Players—this was a difficult path, but it was also the only road that might lead to victory. 'Mo Xiansheng,' his voice returned to calm, 'Of the seven Chess Players, how many identities can currently be confirmed?'

choices.description: Rely not on others, but on one's own layout abilities and Tianji Record, attempting to find a method to independently break the chess game.

text.content: Chen Ji冷笑一声. Searching for other Chess Players? Persuading them to release ten-thousand-year obsessions? Too naive. Rather than placing hope in others, better to rely on one's own strength. He turned and walked deeper into the Tianji Record Fragment, beginning to independently deduce methods to break the chess game.

choices.description: The cost is too great, Chen Ji decides to temporarily set it aside, first solving more urgent problems at hand.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the timing to break the game
choices.risk_hint: The chess game may never be broken

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. The Chess Game of Eternity, the cycle of ten thousand years—these were too distant. At the moment, he had more urgent matters—his sister's safety, the sect's crisis, and those enemies watching covetously. Breaking the game could be discussed later.

Just at this moment, the Tianji Record shuddered again. Mo Xiansheng's voice turned urgent: 'Danger! Someone is deducing the aura of the Tianji Record! It's another Chess Player! They sensed the fluctuation from the sixth page manifesting!' Chen Ji's expression slightly changed. The method he had just obtained hadn't yet been digested, yet the enemy had already come knocking.

dialogue.content: 'They came fast,' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried cold intent, 'It seems it's not just the Heavenly Eye monitoring—other Chess Players are also watching each other. Chen Ji, you must prepare—they won't allow anyone to take the lead in breaking the chess game.

text.content: A cold smile curled at Chen Ji's lips. He had been worried about finding people to deliver themselves, never expecting 'guests' to arrive so quickly. He slowly turned around, facing the darkness beyond the Tianji Record space, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable霸氣: 'Since you're here, don't even think about leaving.'

Three lights suddenly blazed in the space, three figures appearing before Chen Ji simultaneously. The first figure was shrouded in black mist—it was precisely Ye Qing, the Saint of the Demonic Path Holy Sect; the second figure crackled with lightning around them—Xuanwu Sect genius Han Lie; the third figure was most mysterious, hidden beneath layers of fog, their features indistinguishable.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji,' Ye Qing's voice emerged from the black mist, carrying a hint of complexity, 'Congratulations on being the first to解开 the sixth page. However, you should know the rules—before breaking the chess game, all Chess Players are enemies.
'What's the point of talking nonsense with him!' Han Lie roared, thunder force condensing in his hands, '废物就是废物, think解开 the sixth page就能翻身? Let me废了你 first!'

choice.prompt: Three Chess Players appeared simultaneously, the situation on the brink of explosion. Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Show the three the content of the sixth page, use the truth to shake their意志. Extremely high risk, but may directly gain allies.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly projecting the content of the Tianji Record's sixth page into the air. The three's expressions instantly froze—the truth of the Chess Game of Eternity, the operation of the cyclical system—this information struck like thunder in the three's Mental Seas.

choices.description: Don't reveal trump card, first probe the three's bottom line and obsessions, seek cracks that can be exploited.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't rush to act, instead smiling faintly: 'Three honored guests arriving in person, surely not just to kill me? Go ahead, what do you want?' His attitude made all three slightly stunned—this废物, it seemed, wasn't quite as imagined.

choices.description: Temporarily retreat, using the Tianji Record's space transfer ability to leave—留得青山在不怕没柴烧.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't speak, directly activating the Tianji Record's space transfer ability. The moment three figures lunged forward, his form had already vanished. Han Lie's thunder struck empty air, his roar of rage shaking the entire space: '废物! 有种别跑!'

Meanwhile, within the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao abruptly opened her eyes. She was the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect, always Chen Ji's greatest suspect and investigator. But at this moment, she felt an inexplicable panic—as if something she didn't know was happening, and the direction of this matter might completely change the relationship between her and Chen Ji.

In the Tianji Record space, the last trace of Chen Ji's spiritual fluctuation slowly faded. But before fading, he saw a scene that shocked his mind—a seventh figure shrouded in black mist, blurred yet real. She had been there all along, quietly observing all of this, yet never acted. The Seventh Chess Player—Chen Nian.

The last line of the Tianji Record flickered: 'But the seventh Chess Player never truly died'—these words struck like thunder, shattering Chen Ji's soul to pieces. The seventh Chess Player, could that possibly be...
